en: Black‑and‑white image showing a modernist multi‑storey hospital complex surrounded by conifer trees. Several large rectangular buildings with many identical windows and balconies dominate the scene; scaffolding is visible on one wing, suggesting ongoing construction or extension. In the foreground is a smaller building with a pitched roof. White printed captions in Swedish appear in two corners of the image.
